verdict.line: You lose if you let Morde freely stack Obliterate and Darkness Rise on minions, you win if you punish his W cooldown with E-enabled trades.

brief.thesis: This lane is a cooldown war, not a stat check: Mordekaiser's Indestructible (W, 12-8s cooldown) shields and heals off anything he hits, so trading into a full W is wasted damage. Volibear's own kit is built to outlast that shield window — Sky Splitter (E, 16s cooldown, 1200 range) threatens from range to punish shoves, and Frenzied Maul (W, 5s cooldown) rewards double-tapping the same target. The 52.3% win rate over 308 games confirms Volibear's trade pattern beats Morde's when played on his terms.

theirWindow.when: Indestructible is up and he's pushing
theirWindow.what: He can tank your all-in and heal back off the stored damage, so don't commit Q (Thundering Smash) into a fresh W — you'll just refill his shield.

yourWindow.when: W just used, no shield available
yourWindow.what: This is when to engage: Q (Thundering Smash) to stun, then double-W (Frenzied Maul) for the mark-and-heal combo, finishing with E (Sky Splitter) if he tries to walk out of the zone.

start.item: Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion
start.why: Taken in 71.8% of games at 54.2% win rate — the sustain lets you hold trades through Morde's Obliterate poke without losing lane presence.

boots.why: Highest pick rate (50.3%) and win rate (53.7%) — the tenacity matters against Death's Grasp (E) pulls and any CC chain that follows.

core.why: First item in the top win-rate path (53.8% over 52 games), giving the AP/AD hybrid scaling Volibear's kit wants.
Cooldown refresh on crits accelerates your Q/W trade loop, letting you reset Frenzied Maul faster in extended fights.

runes.keystoneWhy: Taken in the top two rune pages (34.9% and 9% pick combined) — the stacking attack speed rewards Volibear's on-hit trade pattern against Morde's slower, cooldown-gated damage.

summoners.why: Highest pick rate at 72.9% and matching win rate of 52.9% — Ignite punishes all-ins where Morde tries to heal off Indestructible's stored shield, denying the sustain that defines his trades.

playing.title: Never engage into fresh W
playing.detail: If Indestructible just came off cooldown, hold your Q (Thundering Smash) — any damage you deal gets banked into his shield and returned as healing.

playing.title: Punish with E after his shove
playing.detail: Sky Splitter (E) has 1200 range and 16s cooldown — use it to zone or chip him the moment he pushes past minions without W up.

playing.title: Double-tap W for the heal
playing.detail: Frenzied Maul's second cast on a marked target heals you — always look to land both casts in a trade, not just one, to win the sustain race.

playing.title: Respect Death's Grasp range
playing.detail: His E pulls from 700 range — don't stand at the wave edge past minute 3-4 when his E cooldown drops to 10s or lower.

playing.title: Use R to punish overextension
playing.detail: Stormbringer (R) at 550 range slows and grants bonus health on landing — save it for when Morde pushes too far past his minions, since his own R needs you isolated to work.

playing.title: Track Darkness Rise stacks
playing.detail: After his passive triggers on 3 hits, he gets a damage aura and move speed — back off trading during that window rather than extending.

playing.title: Splitpush once items complete
playing.detail: By level 13+ with Dusk and Dawn and Navori online, your dueling output outscales his — force him to answer your sidelane pressure.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, runes, and summoner spell choices above come from measured high-elo games on the current patch (16.20.1) via OP.GG; the tactical reasoning and trade-window analysis is this brief's own judgment based on the listed ability mechanics.

stats.opponentTip: Use [E] to contest lane during early game to easily gain lane control. Try to go in for the kill when (W) is on cooldown.
